title: DEIG-Einsatz – Festnahme nach Hausfriedensbruch, Sachbeschädigung und Widerstand gegen Vollstreckungsbeamte

extraction.summaryEn: Police were called to a disturbed man on a residential roof in Zionskirchstraße, who entered an apartment under renovation, barricaded the door and resisted officers. He was arrested after a stun device was used, and faces charges of trespassing, property damage and resisting officers.
